name: Aysen
description: A state founded on the Northern Plains under Serra's protection, center of learning and healing.

description_citations.text: "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Irini Sengir mocks a renegade rallying the rabble as no true Crusader.
timeline.quote: "A renegade rallying the rabble does not a true Crusader make."

citation.text: Aysen Crusader (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eron the Relentless declares a truce: Aysen feeds his band and they do not kill them.
timeline.quote: "The people of Aysen feed us, and we don't kill them. That's my kind of truce."

citation.text: Truce (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Eron forms a treaty with Aysen to keep his subordinates from invading in exchange for trade of food and goods.
timeline.quote: Eron formed a treaty with Aysen

citation.text: "Eron", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Young Ihsan is told by a soothsayer that his dreams mean he is likely doomed by Baron Sengir, and devotes himself to becoming a paladin of Serra.
timeline.quote: Ihsan devoted his life to becoming a Paladin of Serra

citation.text: "Ihsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The people of Aysen come to think Ihsan a traitor; the Serra paladins vow to destroy him.
timeline.quote: The Serra paladins have even vowed to destroy the traitor of their order.

citation.text: "Ihsan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sengir sends vampires against Aysen and enslaves kidnapped humans in the Dark Barony.
timeline.quote: He instigated firm rules: if one person tried to flee the Barony, he would murder ten people in their place.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra arrives, encourages peace among the nomads and founds Aysen, becoming its protector goddess.
timeline.quote: she encouraged peace between the various plains nomads and the foundation of the state of Aysen

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: She took on the role of protector over the people of Aysen, who saw her as a goddess.

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
